summary: Commanded a British frigate; Elder Brother of Trinity House; London merchant; John's 3rd cousin 8x removed.
bio:
Path: Elizabeth → Joseph → Richard → Effingham. His daughter Catharine Maria married Sir John Thomas Jones, 1st Bt, Wellington's engineer.

Third son and seventh child of Richard Lawrence (son of Joseph, son of William & Elizabeth Smith); b. 1734; married Catharine Farmer; moved to London, commanded a British frigate, became an Elder Brother of Trinity House and a merchant at Tower Hill ([R4-S1]). Children: William Effingham, John Curson, Effingham Calvert, Edward Billop and Catharine Maria (wife of Sir John Thomas Jones, Bt, Wellington's aide). 3rd cousin 8 times removed. Note: the Wikipedia article 'Effingham Lawrence' is a different man (Louisiana congressman, 1820-1878).
sources: [R4-S1] Thomas Lawrence, Historical Genealogy of the Lawrence Family (1858) (archive.org full text), pp. 48-49 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historicalgeneal00lawr
